content: Bab-Dummad Israel-dulemarga maná uksad

Bela Israel-dulemar Elimʼye-neg-nugadgi node gusmalad, geb nega-dulesulidganba-Sinʼye-nugadse warmakdapmalad. Sinʼde Elimʼye-neg-nugad-naid, degi, Sinaíʼye-neg-nugad-naid, amar-negabargi naid. Deunni, Egiptoʼgi nii-warbogus gaka-ibambe-gakatargus (15) noarmalad-akalad.
A-nega-dulesulidgangi dulemar bela Moisésʼgi, degi, Aarónʼgi uluarmalad.

Israel-dulemar sogdemalad: “Ar Bab-Jehová Egipto-yargi anmar-oburgwismalana bur nabirinad. Webardi, anmar bormo-ebiris bormo san-ena, nue-immelegedse mas-gundaenad. Ar emidi, bemar we-nega-dulesulidganse bela ukudba-anmar-oburgwega be anmar-nialid.”

Geb degine, Bab-Jehová Moisésʼga sogded: “Bemarga an madu niba batedaged an imakoed. Degine, dulemar, unnila emigadbi madu-weemalaga, bane-bane neg-magaba nomalargebed. Adi, an wilubdakegalad, doamar an-ibmar-sogedba imakmalodibe, doamar imakosurbardibe.
Ibanergwadgindina (6) dulemar ilabo-mergu e-negse-sedega madu weemaloed.”
Moisés, Aarónʼbogwa Israel-dulemarga sogdemalad: “Sedogidba be wisgumaloed, Bab-Jehová, na e, Egipto-yargi bemar-onosye.
Degine, wakdaradbali, Bab-Jehová-e-gangued-yeerdakleged be dakmaloed, ar ade, Bab-Jehová bemar-egi-oimakbukmalad bemar-itosad. ¿Ar anmardi doasunna, ar emide, be anmargi oimakbukmargu?”

Degine, Moisés sogdebalid: “Sedogi Bab-Jehová bemarga san ukoed, adi, a-san be gunmalagar. Wakdardi madu ise-obinagwar bemarga ukoed, ar ade, Bab-Jehová egi be ulusmalad be-itosmalad. ¿Ar anmardi doasunna, anmargi be urwenaimargu? Ar bemar anmargi ulussulid, Bab-Jehováʼgi be ulusmalad.”
Geb degine, Moisés, Aarónʼga sogded: “Israel-dulemarga be soge: ‘Bela Bab-Jehová-asabin ambikudamar, ar ade, Bab-Jehová bemar egi-oimakbukwad bemar-itosad.’ ”
Aarón Israel-dulemarga sunmakgwisgua, bela dulemar nega-dulesulidganba atakdemalad, agi mogir-imbaba Bab-Jehová-e-gangued-yeerdakleged nononikid.
Geb degine, Bab-Jehová Moisésʼga sunmakded, ega sogded:

“Israel-dulemar angi oimakbukwad an itosad. Amar-ebo be sunmak, ega be soge: ‘Emi-sedogi be san gunmaloye, wakdardina, be madu gunmaloye, nue-immelegedseye. Adi, be wisgumalagarye, ani an Bab-Jehová guye, ani an bemar-Bab-Dummadye.’ ”
A-sedogidgine, nuumar-codornizʼye-nugad nonimalad, bia Israel-dulemar-bukwadgi ena ambikunonimalad. Degine, wakdaradbali, Israel-dulemar-bukwad-dikarba dii bominonikid.
Dii-bomisad-dingudgu, sorba daklealid nega-dulesulidgan-napagi ibmar-dataragwad, dii-akwaga-binnisadyob-daklege omilede.
Ar Israel-dulemar wissurmarsoggu, wede ibua, a-ular, a-dakarmalale, na muchub-muchub egisdedamalad: “¿Wede ibua?” Geb Moisés ega sogded: “We madu, Bab-Jehová bemarga uked, adi, be mas-gunmalagar.
Bab-Jehová bemarga soged, weyob bemar imakoye: Na be mergu-gunmaladba, wargwen-wargwen weenamaloye. Degine, na be be-neggi mergu-dule-nikadba, wala-walagwengi nibirbo-wilub-mergu weemaloye.”
Israel-dulemala deyob imaksamalad. Gwen-gwen bur ichesur wesmalad, gwen-gwen bur ichee wesmalad.
Deyob weemaloye-soglesadba wesmalad. Ar dule-ichesur-wesadga obichasulid, dule-ichee-wesadga akussurmogad. Na e-mergu gunnedba, wala-walagwen egad-egad wesmalad.
Geb degine, Moisés Israel-dulemarga sogded: “Bemar bipisaale melle banedga we-masgunned be sabomalo.”

Degi-inigwele, dulemar abala Moisés-sogedba imaksasurmalad, abar banedga sabosmalad. Banedga-sabosmaladi, ei nusbiin gusad, bela nunu-yapan oiboalid. Geb degine, Moisés amargi nue-sae-itoded, ese uluded.
Na e-mergu-gunmaladbali, wakdaradba egad-egad weenaddamalad, ar ade, dad-diopisurgudele, dad-abin diree naddaed.
Ibanergwadgindi (6), ilabo-wilub mas wesmalad. A sogledo, wala-walagwengi nibirbake-wilub wesmarye. Geb degine, neg-danar-danar-bukmalad-e-dummagan ibmar-gusad Moisésʼga sognadmalad.

Agi, Moisés amarga sogded: “Ar weyob Bab-Jehová igar uksad. Oibosale, obunnoged-ibad. We-iba, Bab-Jehováʼgadid. Emi bemar mas-yobiedi, emi be yomalodo. Emi mas-dulebiedi, emi be mas dumalodo. Bemarga-mas-obinoedi, banedga be sabomaloed.”
Ibmar-obichadi, Moisés-igar-uksadba sabosmalad, adi, oibosar gunmalagar. We-ibmar nungussulid, nusbiin gussurbalid.
Geb degine, Moisés sogded: “Emi obunnoged-ibad, Bab-Jehová-ibad. We-ibmar emi be gunmar. Ar emi-ibagi, we-ibmar, babatenai, degi, napagi-mellemai gwen be dakosurmalad.
Bemar sunna ibanergwa (6) we-ibmar weemaloed. Ar ibagugledgindina (7), obunnoged-ibad. A-ibagi, we-ibmar sate guoed.”
Degite, gwenna-gwennagwa ibagugledgine (7) wis ibmar-weenamalaga, node gusmalad. A-ibmar wessurgusmalad, ar ade, a-ibagi a-ibmar gwen daksasurgusmalad.
Geb degine, Bab-Jehová Moisésʼga sogded: “¿Ar wede sanagwadse an-igar-mamaidba, an bemarga-ibmar-sogedba be nanamaloye soge?

Ani, Bab-Jehová, an bemarga ibagwen-obunnoged-iba uksanad. Agala, ibanergwadgine (6), an bemarga masgunned ibabo-wilub uksad. Degisoggu, ibagugledgine (7), bemar na e-neg-e-neggi megewilubmalanad, bemar na be-neggine noewilubsurmalanad.”
Geb degine, dulemar ibagugledgine (7) obunnosmalad.
Israel-dulemala we-ibmar-weemaladi, bismalad: “Manáʼye.” We-ibmarde, e-gwag sipugwad, gagan-wawadikid-culantroʼye-nugad-e-gwagyobid, degi, madu-dibyaled achanis egi eoaledyob gulleged.

Geb sorbali, Moisés sogded: “Weyob Bab-Jehová bemarga igar uked: ‘Bormogi nibirbake be maná enomalo. Bemar be-waganga be nue sabomalo, adi, be-wagan dakmalaga, Egipto-yargi an bemar-onosmargu, igid-mas an bemarga nega-dulesulidganba uksa gusa.’ ”
Geb degine, Moisés Aarónʼga sogded: “Bormo gwagwen be sue, agi nibirbake be maná urboed. A-sorbali, Bab-Jehová-asabin be sioed, adi, bemar-waganga-oyogega be sabogoed.”
Igi Bab-Jehová Moisésʼga igar-uksa, deyob, Aarón, we-maná sabogega, bormogi Bab-Jehová-Dadganbo-Igar-Mesisad-Ulu-asabin sisad.
Israel-dulemala birga-dulabo (40) maná-gundii gusmalad. Canaán-yargi dulemar-bukwadse-mosmaladse we-maná gundii gusmalad.
Ibmar-wilubsaed-gomerʼgwensak nibirbake gued. Gomer-gwambeddi (10) ibmar-wilubsaed-efa-gwensak gued.
